entities.summary: Crispina Peres was a performers & entertainers in Guinea-Bissau (1615 – 1700), a notable figure of the Early Modern era. Their work intersected with economic development and trade and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Influenced economic patterns and commercial practices.
